titleEn: Law on the establishment of the Ministry of Environment

articles.en: The Ministry of Environment is hereby established under the Royal Government of Cambodia.
The Ministry of Environment shall have the competence to lead and manage the environment sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
The Ministry of Environment shall be led by one Minister, who may be assisted by Secretaries of State and/or Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
The organisational structure and functioning of the Ministry of Environment shall be determined by sub-decree.
Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at Phnom Penh, 24 January 1996, and respectfully submitted for the Royal signature; Norodom Sihanouk; First Prime Minister, Second Prime Minister; Norodom Ranariddh, Hun Sen.
Norodom Ranariddh, Hun Sen.
NS/RKM/0196/01
